records.Concise description: Bitcoin AMM for Runes with PSBT swap APIs and pool-wallet liquidity mechanics.
records.Deeper researched summary: Runes DEX presents itself as the first decentralized AMM on Bitcoin for Runes and uses liquidity pools rather than a conventional order book. Current documentation shows BTC/Runes pool deposits, LP tokens, constant-product pricing and wallet-signed swap flows; the API can return a PSBT for swap execution. Critically, its fee documentation says fee coins are physically located on a pool wallet and controlled by that pool wallet before treasury withdrawal. That detail constrains broad 'self-custody' marketing language: users may trade from their own wallets, but pool assets and treasury-fee mechanics involve pool-wallet control.
Creators / founders: Runes DEX team; CEO/founder is publicly known pseudonymously as 'King of Runes' in independent funding coverage
records.Launch / history: Launched around the April 2024 Runes activation and was independently reported as a purpose-built Runes AMM backed by a seed financing round. Current docs/API remain available in 2026.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin marketplac: Runes DEX is historically and technically significant as an early dedicated AMM design for Runes, contrasting with fixed-UTXO marketplace listings.

Corroborating sources.label: The Block — Runes DEX secures $2 million seed investment

records.Verification basis: Current product/API docs establish operation and mechanics; independent funding coverage supports launch-era significance.
Research notes / uncertainties: MEDIUM because first-party materials use broad self-custody/decentralization language while fee/pool documentation reveals pool-wallet control that requires more architectural clarification. Do not publish 'fully non-custodial liquidity pools' without resolving that distinction. Fee percentages are current-doc facts, not timeless constants.

records.Entity / project type: Ordinals marketplace plus marketplace API/infrastructure product
records.Concise description: Trio is OrdinalsBot’s live Bitcoin marketplace, backed by OrdinalsBot PSBT trading and reusable marketplace/launchpad APIs.
records.Deeper researched summary: Trio is the current consumer marketplace product of OrdinalsBot (Orange Dollars Inc.), while OrdinalsBot also exposes marketplace infrastructure for third parties. The live Trio site supports Ordinals collection trading and currently offers migration of legacy Magic Eden listings. Trio terms identify Ordinals Bot / Orange Dollars Inc. as the service operator and define supported NFT/inscription scope broadly across BRC-20s, Runes, BTC inscriptions and related Bitcoin protocols. OrdinalsBot's official product documentation describes a PSBT-based order-book marketplace for fungible and non-fungible inscriptions, while its Marketplace API lets third parties create marketplaces/launchpads, generate seller listing PSBTs, construct purchases, set marketplace fee destinations and query market data. MSC therefore consolidates Trio and the directly underlying OrdinalsBot marketplace infrastructure into one profile instead of duplicating the company and its marketplace product.
Creators / founders: David Henderson (OrdinalsBot founders, per official OrdinalsBot/TRIO documentation)
records.Launch / history: OrdinalsBot launched February 7, 2023 as an automated inscription service and expanded into marketplace/API infrastructure. The Trio marketplace product was announced in 2024 and remains reachable with active marketplace surfaces in 2026.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin marketplac: Trio/OrdinalsBot bridges a consumer trading venue and reusable Bitcoin marketplace infrastructure: the same ecosystem exposes PSBT-based listing/purchase mechanics and APIs that other teams can use to build branded markets.
Important technical or cultural characte: BRC-20 and broader inscription trading support in product documentation

Corroborating sources.label: Business Wire — OrdinalsBot seed round and Trio marketplace announcement

records.Verification basis: Live Trio marketplace surfaces, current Trio terms, official OrdinalsBot/TRIO product docs and marketplace API docs verify the combined product/company scope and PSBT marketplace infrastructure.
Research notes / uncertainties: One-entity rule: keep Trio and OrdinalsBot's directly underlying marketplace infrastructure together in this Marketplaces profile unless Command Center intentionally creates a broader cross-category OrdinalsBot master entity. Do not infer that every protocol named in Trio terms has equally deep current liquidity. Recheck specific Runes/BRC-20 trading surfaces before protocol-specific public copy.
